fwi_1985.csv.definition: Van Wagner and Pickett 1985 sequential weather/test table, reproduced by CFFDRS R, rounded to 1 decimal (DSR to 2). Initial FFMC85/DMC6/DC15, latitude40. Pure tabular numerical reference; no upstream implementation copied.

solar: NREL SPA report NREL/TP-560-34302 (2003), example true zenith50.127954, azimuth194.340241; pvlib Erbs/isotropic/PVWatts reference implementation
wind: DTU Rotor equivalent wind speed for power curve measurement, 2014 comparative exercise: cube root sum Ai/A * vi^3; independent Gauss-Legendre disk-chord integration

visibility.algorithm: NOAA-EMC UPP CALVIS.f method R, raw mixture volume and MAX(0,concentration),2%contrast,24.135kmceiling

hdw: Srock et al 2018, The Hot-Dry-Windy Index: A New Fire Weather Index, Atmosphere9(7)279; USDA HDWI documentation
icing: NWS Houston Icing Hazards: liquid below0C, rare to-40C. This product is supercooled liquid content, not severity.
